issue.title: Optional per-intention met/partly/missed marks in the intention card editor

task_type_fields.proposal:
Let Bryan optionally mark each intention met, partly met, or missed (✓ / ◐ / ✗) in the intention card editor, stored alongside the `intentions` list on daily and week/quarter/year notes and shown in the intention card. Marks are Bryan's alone: agents never grade them, and `bob periods brief` may at most report them verbatim.

Proposed scope: choose the storage contract (for example a parallel `intention_marks` list or per-item objects; it must keep `intentions` readable by existing clients and fit the owned-field fingerprint used by `bob periods update`), add guarded `bob periods update` ops for setting/clearing a mark with inverse ops for Undo, extend the intention card and its `==` editor in bob-plugins (bob-ledger-tools), update docs/periods.md and docs/intention-card.md, and decide whether the brief exposes the marks.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: plan:202611/period_intentions.md lists "Per-intention outcome marks" as Out of scope and asks the adopt phase to record "optional per-intention ✓/◐/✗ marks" as a follow-up; it needs its own storage-contract decision. Proposed by bob-cli-nh.8 note #5; triaged by the bob-cli-nh land agent.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-nh's plan deferred per-intention outcome marks as an optional follow-up needing its own storage contract.
